# openwebui_tool_server_verify (Data Source)

Verifies that an external tool server is reachable and returns a valid OpenAPI spec.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openwebui_tool_server_verify" "local_tools" {
  url  = "http://tools.internal:8080"
  path = "/openapi.json"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path to the OpenAPI spec endpoint, e.g. `/openapi.json`.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the tool server to verify.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type for the tool server, e.g. `bearer`.
- `config_json` (String) Additional JSON configuration for the verification request.
- `headers_json` (String) JSON object of additional HTTP headers to send. e.g. `jsonencode({ X-Api-Version = "2" })`.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key or bearer token. Sensitive.
- `type` (String) Tool server type identifier.

### Read-Only

- `verified` (Boolean) `true` if the server responded with a valid OpenAPI spec.
